summary: A party worker files for a precinct post after seeing its duties go undone.
realLife: Laura Loyacono sought a Kansas City precinct committee seat after noticing how little some incumbents did.
inGame: needs: a precinct committee vacancy or filing and a record of the incumbent's duties.

turns.what: The worker helps the incumbent make the rounds instead of filing against them.
turns.pulledBy: The incumbent asks for help covering the precinct.
turns.writesBack: The two share the next canvass.

turns.what: The worker misses the filing date and asks to fill the next vacancy.
turns.pulledBy: The neglected assignment comes to light after filing closes.
turns.writesBack: The party has a volunteer on record for a later opening.
